name: Credits (prepaid run-time gating)
author: joeskolengaden
description: Prepaid / metered lighting. The device is granted a balance of credits and burns one credit per running hour (no RTC needed - uses the monotonic clock). When the balance hits zero all channel output is forced off until a password-protected admin tops it up. Admin can also enable/disable the plugin.

settingsSchema.label: Plugin enabled
settingsSchema.help: Master switch. When off, lights are never gated. (Admin only in the UI.)

settingsSchema.label: Seconds per credit
settingsSchema.help: How long one credit lasts. 3600 = one credit per hour. Lower it to test.

settingsSchema.label: Count time
settingsSchema.help: running = burn credits whenever the device is on; playing = only while a sequence is playing.

settingsSchema.label: Channels to blank
settingsSchema.help: How many channels to force to 0 when out of credits. Default covers any home display; set to your exact channel count if larger.

settingsSchema.label: Recharge to (credits)
settingsSchema.help: Target balance for a top-up. Applied once when recharge_token changes (admin sets both via the UI).

settingsSchema.label: Recharge token
settingsSchema.help: Change this (with recharge_value) to set the balance to recharge_value. The plugin applies each new token exactly once.

settingsSchema.label: Admin password hash
settingsSchema.help: bcrypt hash of the admin password (set from the UI). Never store the plaintext here.
